findingsResolved: Bind classifier and reply qualification to reviewed Textbutler sources as well as XCB evidence
Reject contradictory custody failures and signal exits
Prime readiness on restart and refresh stale capability metadata with shutdown cancellation
Bind app, daemon and setup results to exact immutable artifacts and launch generation
Use app-scoped native Messages consent without sending an event
Preserve already-bound Ghostget auth incarnation on repeat setup
Preserve first accepted account identity independently of failed attempts and latest results
Retain accepted owner job identity after timeout or disconnected polling without repeating the original operation
Keep owner history and summary samples bounded with explicit omissions and exact recipient revalidation
Share current capability, target, asset and review-digest checks across suggested and explicitly composed rich drafts

Reject Ghostget 0.18.18 before native setup launch and require an exact 0.18.19 capability snapshot before permission grants
review.remaining: The synthetic 0.18.19 fixture proves exact version admission and rejection behavior, not the actual Ghostget release or its protected-folder startup fix. Native app execution, macOS permissions, exact XCB executable/provider admission, account/recipient verification and live messaging behavior are separate evidence; this receipt makes no live-provider or delivery claim.
